title: finding-list.v1
description: S055 §5.2 — output of a ratify-design `extract-findings` stage (one per ballot). Each finding carries an EXACT citation; the script substring-checks every quote against the ballot's raw_transcript — a non-matching quote => extraction_suspect => NEEDS-FOLLOWUP. Owner: forge. Consumed by ratify-design verify-findings + assemble.

ballot_source.description: Which consultant ballot this was extracted from.

extraction_suspect.description: True when at least one quote failed the substring cross-check against raw_transcript.

cited_quote.description: Verbatim quote that MUST appear at cited_path.
